svg.title: fourPNO
svg.desc: Hexagonal logo for the R package fourPNO, which fits the four-parameter normal-ogive item response model. A bold S-shaped curve, the item response curve at the posterior medians a = 1.69, b = .72, g = .21 and s = .13, divides the hex: everything below it is solid ink, running off both sides. An orange 95 percent credible band runs along the curve, wide at the floor and the ceiling and thinnest across the rise. The word fourPNO is set straight across the steep middle, 'four' in ink on the open plate and 'PNO' cut out of the form, its seam on the inflection. Four thin lines label the four parameters: a horizontal line at the guessing floor, labelled g, and another at the slipping ceiling, labelled one minus s, each running the full width; the tangent at the inflection, labelled a, rising from the floor line to the ceiling line behind the seam of the word; and a drop line from the inflection down to probability zero, labelled b over a, the curve's location, .43. A faint dot grid rules the open plate. In the animated version the four lines step through the sampler's first five posterior draws, the floor and the ceiling moving within the band's flat ends and the tangent swinging, then settle back on the medians.
